theorems.name: Submission.frt_hnw_exists_open_superset_measure_lt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U Z : Set (Euclidean N)) (ζ : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → Z ⊆ U → μ Z = 0 → 0 < ζ → ∃ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O ∧ Z ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ U ∧ μ O < ζ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
